en: Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate town hall building with a tall clock tower topped by a spire and weather vane. The architecture has elaborate decorative gables and red tiled roofs. In front of the building stands a sculpted fountain or monument in an open square. The sky is blue with a few clouds. Printed text at the top identifies the location and the building.
